messages.author: daffc1958e88638f
messages.subject: failure to converge in common factor gwas
parts:
Dear authors,

I had issues with common factor gwas runtime (resources_used.cput=3012:11:58) with 38 cores. As suggested by you (Michel and Andrew) at https://groups.google.com/forum/m/#!topic/genomic-sem-users/ZJtXg56fQsg, I did the following.

1) I tried the common factor model without SNP effects. It had problems with convergence (see below):
> commonfactor_DWLS <- commonfactor(covstruc = LDSCoutput, estimation="DWLS")
[1] "The common factor initially failed to converge. A lower bound of 0 on residual variances has been added to try and troubleshoot this."
[1] "The common factor model failed to converge on a solution. Please try specifying an alternative model using the usermodel function."
Error in lav_fit_measures(object = object, fit.measures = fit.measures, :
lavaan ERROR: fit measures not available if model did not converge


2) I also used the first 100 snps in the common factor gwas with a cluster of 38 cpus. And it had 38 warnings below. I think these warnings were related to the 38 cores requested and caused by the failure to converge as indicated above.
> SNPs <- commonfactor_sumstats[1:100, ]
> cores <- 38
> covstruc <- LDSCoutput
> snp100_commonfactor_gwas <- commonfactorGWAS(covstruc = covstruc, SNPs = SNPs, cores=cores)
[1] "Please note that an update was made to commonfactorGWAS on 11/21/19 so that it combines addSNPs and commonfactorGWAS."
This is lavaan 0.6-5
lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: failure to converge in common factor gwas
parts:
Hi Patrick, 

The warnings about closing unused connections are safe to ignore for the userGWAS function, but I would recommend trouble shooting the model without SNPs prior to moving onto the GWAS. It sounds like you are already digging into that using the usermodel function. I would note that if you specify a common factor within the usermodel it should print the point estimates for the final iteration when of running the model when it doesn't converge, which may help in troubleshooting. With that said, feel free to post usermodel output here if you are still stuck. 

-Andrew
